This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

Hillbilly armor was tank warfare’s ultimate hack—scrap steel, sandbags, tracks, and logs added in the field when official upgrades were too slow. Ugly, heavy, sometimes life-saving, and still echoed in modern vehicle cages. Which tank upgrade era should we cover next?
